refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
Gets the number of children branch node has.
* `Parent` is the node from which to retrieve the number of children.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: If `Parent` is a branch node, the return value is the number of child nodes the `Parent` has. Otherwise, the return value is -1 to indicate that `Parent` is not a branch.
